name: Joushi to Himitsu no 2 LDK
source:
You work for a publishing house, and you’ve decided it’s time to start living on your own. But…what’s this? Your coworker is in your new home?! As your new roommate hands you the key, your secret life together begins…

You come home together after work, you share drinks on the porch…you might even see him in the bath, or be asked for a goodnight kiss! Experience the unique excitement of living together. Make choices and find your happy ending.

[From [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/73586009343/our-two-bedroom-story-2ldk-release]English Otome Games[/url]]
